summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for ZARKHEZ AI: a cinematic, interactive 3D web presentation built in vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript with Three.js. It features 12 full-screen projector-optimized slides, an interactive 3D Earth zooming into South Punjab (Bahawalpur, Bahawalnagar, Rahim Yar Khan), a 3D hyperspectral cube explorer, pipeline animations, M1-M6 module tabs, real ML metrics with interactive sliders, an Android phone mockup, a 9-month Gantt timeline, and a presenter notes HUD.
